text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementTechnologyThere is Still Time to Stall the AI ApocalypseBut it would require a new kind of chip that restricts trainingKFBy Kristen French12:00 PM CST on November 19, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleWho hasn’t worried of late that the AI apocalypse is nigh? Just in the past few days, air traffic control,  banking, communication, security or other network systems in the United States and around the world have gone down, stoking fears of AI-powered cyberattacks. Powered By 10 ShareNextStaySuch fears really took off in September, when many AI insiders began sounding the doomsday alarm, following incidents in which AI agents acted in ways that their human handlers hadn’t intended, such as the Hugging Face attack.
